programs.name: recency_weighted_seasonal_cv
programs.description: Use when rolling seasonal holdout errors improve toward the forecast origin, as the observed 11.09%, 7.99%, and 5.10% SMAPE scores do.
programs.assumption: On the next 24-point holdout, a candidate selected with chronological fold weights 1, 2, and 4 achieves SMAPE at least 0.5 percentage points below the parent's 8.06% historical mean SMAPE.
programs.failure_condition: It fails if the next holdout SMAPE is at least 7.56%, or if fewer than three complete seasonal cycles are available for recency-weighted validation.
